title: MovieReviewer
desc: Website for movie reviews with user authentication. App allows user to add reviews for their favorite movies and also add comments to reviews.

title: WorkingOut
desc: A specialized web application designed for fitness enthusiasts to manage their daily workout routines. The app allows users to create personalized exercise lists, track sets and reps, and organize their training by days of the week.

title: RESTEasy
desc: Is a Windows desktop application for sending and testing HTTP requests to REST APIs. It provides a simple interface for configuring requests and inspecting server responses.
